newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Virgin's Ornstein says not seeking TWA job.
newsitem.headline: Virgin's Ornstein says not seeking TWA job.

text.p: Jonathan Ornstein, chief executive of low-cost European air carrier Virgin Express, denied press reports on Monday that he was seeking a job at Trans World Airlines (TWA).

The Wall Street Journal earlier reported that Ornstein was considered the only serious candidate for the top position at TWA. In recent days two other candidates dropped out in the face of labour opposition to their price-tags, the WSJ story said.
"I don't have any intention of going to TWA for a job. I have a job here," Ornstein told Reuters by telephone.

"I'm very happy in my current position, I just leased an apartment in Brussels for three years and we just put together a deal with (Belgian national airline) Sabena. I think there's a tremendous opportunity here," Ornstein said.
Ornstein is former president and chief executive of Continental Airlines Inc 's wholly owned Continental Express Inc unit.
